title: Contract Workforce Wave 5K legal review decision boundary
crossFamilyRequirements: Keep OSHWC, EPF and ESI decisions separately fingerprinted and separately source-scoped.
Do not infer EPF/ESI applicability from an OSHWC contract-workforce result.
Do not infer OSHWC contract-labour applicability from an EPF or ESI contractor result.
Treat Maharashtra 2026 OSHWC Labour Rules as draft-only until an exact final instrument is controlled and approved.
notes: Passing deterministic, retrieval or browser tests is not legal approval.
Exact controlled OSHWC full-file acquisition and qualified legal/privacy/RAG review remain open gates.
